common_operational_rules.H2: latest immutable receipt at or before kickoff_at-PT2H; maximum staleness 15 minutes
common_operational_rules.H24: latest immutable receipt at or before kickoff_at-PT24H; maximum staleness 120 minutes
common_operational_rules.consensus: median across at least five complete bookmakers unless a stricter stratum threshold is frozen
common_operational_rules.price_band_eligibility: raw median decimal odds, branch-neutral, so both de-vig branches test identical fixtures
common_operational_rules.primary_parameter: exactly one per hypothesis and per de-vig branch; branches remain separate
common_operational_rules.training_only_parameters: quantiles and standardization use the expanding training block and remain frozen for the next scored block
